query:
SELECT c.id as conversationId, c.agentId, c.createdAt, 
       a.id as actualAgentId, a.name as agentName
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN agents a ON c.agentId = a.id
WHERE c.createdAt < '2024-12-01'
ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
